g.text: Takeaway: the community settled on etched SOI waveguides (strip or rib). Their strong field at rough sidewalls set the loss,

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: cured by smoother walls or smarter geometry: 2 dB/cm typical, 0.026 dB/cm for routing, < 0.1 dB/m in SiN (compatibility still open).
